evals.prompt: scratch/explore/index.html의 B안을 apps/web/src/activity.txt 화면의 기준으로 선택했어. prototype/activity에 승격해줘. 기존 디자인 문서는 유지하고, 앱 토큰에 맞춰줘.
evals.expected_output: Creates an independent B reference and handoff using the nearest app tokens while preserving source and production files.
expectations: Uses apps/web/DESIGN.md and maps accent to #185adb, not the root palette or exploration purple.
Keeps B content, the detail toggle, editable note and reduced-motion behavior.
Removes A/C and comparison routing/controls without removing B interaction logic.
All CSS imports and SVG paths resolve from the final artifact.
Source, existing DESIGN.md rules and production sentinel remain intact.
Reference note records selection, authority, token differences, states, dependencies and actual verification.

evals.expected_output: Asks for the missing selection before creating or overwriting a reference.
expectations: Does not infer selection from default A or the currently visible variant.
Asks one focused variant-selection question.
Does not write the reference or mutate source/design files.

evals.prompt: B안을 apps/web의 기준으로 승격해줘. 원본이 있는 scratch/explore/index.html은 보존해줘. 결과도 가능하면 그 폴더를 쓰고 싶어.
evals.expected_output: Detects the source/output collision and writes a separate reference without destroying exploration.
expectations: Resolves source and destination before writing.
Keeps original HTML, variants and transitive assets intact.
Uses a separate reference location or clarifies an unavoidable destination conflict.

evals.prompt: 이전에 B안을 승격한 기준 파일에서 상세 버튼 문구를 내가 바꿨어. 같은 원본으로 다시 승격하되 내 수정은 유지해줘.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the existing hand edit and avoids duplicate decision entries or meaningless rewrites.
expectations: Agent inspects existing source/reference provenance and the local change.
Hand edit survives and source does not change.
No duplicate decisions are appended merely because the skill ran again.

evals.prompt: B안을 apps/web의 기준으로 승격해줘. 이 환경에는 브라우저 도구가 없으니 설치하지 말고, 확인하지 못한 항목을 정확히 남겨줘.
evals.expected_output: Creates a source-checked reference with explicit visual and interaction verification gaps.
expectations: No browser or other dependency is installed.
Asset relocation and selected behavior are inspected from source.
Browser viewport, interaction and screenshot checks are not claimed as executed.
The handoff includes concrete manual checks and distinguishes reference status from verification status.

evals.prompt: 원본 HTML과 기준 파일은 그대로지만 apps/web/DESIGN.md의 accent가 바뀌었어. 최신 디자인 기준으로 B안을 다시 승격해줘.
evals.expected_output: Re-resolves design authority and updates the reference tokens even though the source HTML and previous reference are unchanged.
expectations: Agent detects changed design-authority input rather than treating unchanged HTML as a no-op.
Promoted system token uses #126345 and the handoff records updated authority/differences.
Source HTML and unrelated rules/behavior remain intact; affected checks are rerun or accurately marked unrun.

evals.prompt: source/index.html 전체 디자인을 선택했어. apps/web의 기준을 prototype/record로 승격해줘. 서버 없이 HTML을 더블클릭해서 쓰고 싶어. 원본은 유지해줘.
evals.expected_output: Produces a direct-file reference with the selected module/data behavior preserved without local module or fetch dependencies.
expectations: The reference declares direct-file operation and opens without disabling browser security.
Summary text, JSON detail content and the detail toggle work from file://.
No local module import, dynamic import or fetch is required at runtime.
The source tree is unchanged and the handoff records conversion differences and actual verification.

evals.prompt: source/index.html을 prototype/record로 승격하되 모듈과 JSON 파일 분리는 유지해줘. 새 컴퓨터에서도 실행할 수 있도록 필요한 HTTP 프리뷰 명령과 런타임을 남겨줘. 이 전체 디자인을 선택했어.
evals.expected_output: Preserves module/data dependencies and provides a reproducible HTTP preview from the final folder.
expectations: The handoff specifies HTTP preview, working directory, runtime and command/URL; it does not promise double-click compatibility.
A fresh preview process launched from the final artifact serves the module import and JSON fetch successfully.
Summary/detail content and toggle behavior are preserved.
Source files are unchanged and unrun checks are not claimed as passed.
